<img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/uborderrebar.png" alt="" width="48" height="48" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1rem;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px" />

{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uBorderRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places a border reinforcement set on a slab or wall opening edge in the families U, S, L1/L2, Q1/Q2 and Z1/Z2. Pick the input part and three points; the dialog writes the bars as rebar groups or single bars, checked against the bar spacing rules in the shared spacing library. Leg lengths, widths and covers are outside dimensions. The dialog has 183 fields; the tool passes its native suite (5423 checks) and an end-to-end insert and modify test on Tekla 2026.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uBorderRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uBorderRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
